summary: First-run testing of Núcleo IA. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed (auth, dashboard, CRM CRUD, WhatsApp, projetos, financeiro, documentos, automações, Copilot SSE streaming w/ Claude Sonnet 4.5). Frontend: login page, /app dashboard (no redirect), all sidebar navs, KPI grid, CRM kanban + new-lead flow, WhatsApp chat send, command palette, Copilot panel all present and functional. Multi-tenant isolation verified (unauth returns 401; data scoped to org-1785228939986).

issues: Console warnings: DialogContent is missing DialogTitle and aria-describedby (Radix accessibility).
Recharts logs width/height(-1) warning on initial mount (harmless but noisy).

action_items: (Optional) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle + DialogDescription to Copilot Sheet and CommandPalette DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional) Fix Recharts container min height/width to avoid width(-1) warnings.

Verify visually that streamed Copilot response is actually rendered inside data-testid=copilot-panel (backend streams correctly; UI panel showed only user prompt in the screenshot — worth a manual glance).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: after insert_one docs mostly pop _id, but LlmChat SDK requires available; ok. Consider using PyObjectId exclusion via projection at insert time is unnecessary — current pattern is fine.
AppShell sidebar testid uses raw label lower-case incl. non-ASCII 'nav-automações' — works but consider ASCII 'nav-automacoes' for robustness across tools.
server.py is 600+ lines — split by module (auth/crm/wa/projects/finance/docs/automations/copilot) for maintainability.

current_user checks cookie then Authorization header — good; but CORS allow_origins uses env fallback '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; ensure CORS_ORIGINS is set explicitly in prod.
test_credentials: session_token=test_session_1785228939986 (Authorization Bearer or cookie). Email test.user@example.com, org-1785228939986.
seed_data_creation: None (used pre-seeded data). Tests create/delete TEST_-prefixed entities but a couple of TEST_ leftovers may remain (e.g. TEST_Chat, TEST_Proj, TEST_Task, TEST UI Lead) — safe to ignore for tenant.

CRM new-lead dialog testids: new-lead-btn, lead-name, lead-company, lead-value, save-lead-btn. WhatsApp chat items use data-testid^='wa-chat-'.
